headline: South Korea KOSPI Drops 1.4% Ahead of Major Tech Earnings
summary: South Korea's KOSPI index slid 1.4 percent below 5,500 as foreign investors offloaded equities ahead of upcoming quarterly earnings reports from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
why: Semiconductor giants Samsung and SK Hynix are heavyweights in South Korean equity indices and vital indicators for global technology hardware demand.

impacts.name: South Korean Equities
impacts.why: Foreign capital outflows driven by earnings caution place downward pressure on local indices.

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding upcoming earnings reports for key technology sector heavyweights prompted foreign institutional investors to reduce exposure.
